source: sanitized Windows vendor-API phantom-power encoding plus live write/read-back/restore validation

golden_encoding.encoding: one byte per supported input; zero disables and one enables 48V phantom power

live_validation.safety_confirmation: both inputs were confirmed disconnected or connected only to phantom-safe balanced equipment
live_validation.procedure: read original; write the inverse boolean; read back; restore original; read back
live_validation.result: both temporary values and both restored values matched

limitations: The successful write used the registered Windows vendor API; the underlying USB setup packet has not been captured with USBPcap.
